Privacy Policy – Garima Vidya Vihar Sr. Sec. School

At Garima Vidya Vihar Sr. Sec. School, we are committed to safeguarding the privacy of students, parents, and visitors who use our website and online services. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your personal information, especially when processing online payments via Razorpay.

1. Information We Collect

Personal Information

When you use our online services (such as paying school fees or submitting an inquiry), we may collect the following details:

  • Name, contact number, and email address
  • Student details (e.g., name, class, admission number)
  • Payment-related information (e.g., transaction details, Razorpay payment ID)
  • Any other information you voluntarily provide through forms or communications

Technical Information

We may also collect non-personal technical information automatically, such as:

  • IP address and browser type
  • Device type and operating system
  • Usage statistics about how you interact with our website

2. How We Use the Information

We use your information to:

  • Process online payments securely via Razorpay
  • Respond to queries or requests submitted through the website
  • Send important updates, reminders, or receipts related to school services
  • Improve the functionality and user experience of our website

We do not use your information for unrelated marketing or share it without your consent.

3. Sharing of Information

We may share your data in the following cases:

  • With trusted third parties like Razorpay for payment processing
  • To comply with legal obligations or regulatory requests
  • To protect the rights, safety, or security of our users, staff, or school

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to any third parties.

4. Data Retention

We retain your personal information for as long as needed to fulfill the purposes stated in this policy. Payment-related data may be retained for legal and accounting purposes, as required by applicable laws.

5. Children’s Privacy

Our website is intended for parents or guardians. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13. If such information is found to be submitted, we will delete it promptly upon notification.

6. Security of Your Information

We take appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your information:

  • Payment information is processed securely via Razorpay using encryption
  • Access to data is limited to authorized personnel
  • We regularly review and update our security practices

While we strive to protect your information, no digital transmission or storage method can be guaranteed 100% secure.

7. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Any changes will be reflected on this page with the revised date. We recommend reviewing this policy regularly to stay informed.

8. Your Consent

By using our website and making payments online, you agree to this Privacy Policy and consent to the collection and use of your information as described herein.

9. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, please contact us at:

Email: info@garimaschool.com
Website: https://www.garimaschool.com

No Refund & Cancellation Policy

Garima Vidya Vihar Sr. Sec. School

Thank you for choosing to pay your fees online through our website. Please read the following No Refund & Cancellation Policy carefully before making any payments.

1. All Payments Are Non-Refundable

At Garima Vidya Vihar Sr. Sec. School, all fees and payments made through our online platform (including via Razorpay) are non-refundable under any circumstances. This includes, but is not limited to:

  • Admission Fees
  • Tuition Fees
  • Exam Fees
  • Transport Fees
  • Late Fees or Penalties
  • Any other charges collected through our website

Once a payment is successfully completed, it cannot be cancelled, refunded, or transferred.

2. No Cancellation of Services

As payments are tied to academic and administrative services (such as student registration, fee collection, etc.), cancellations are not applicable once the payment has been processed.

3. Duplicate Transactions

In case of an accidental duplicate payment, please contact the school office immediately with valid proof (transaction ID, date, and amount). After internal verification and approval, the school may initiate a refund or adjustment at its sole discretion.

To report a duplicate payment, email us at:
📩 info@garimaschool.com

4. No Exchange or Transfer

Paid services or amounts cannot be exchanged or transferred between students or for different services.

5. Dispute Resolution

For any disputes related to payments, kindly contact the school administration directly. We aim to resolve genuine cases with transparency and fairness, as per our internal policies.

For questions related to payments or this policy, please contact:
Garima Vidya Vihar Sr. Sec. School

🌐 www.garimaschool.com
